variants.headline: Still in view: assembly votes down government bill
variants.sub: The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government.
variants.body:
A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

A legislature is supposed to decide, not merely to decorate a government's intentions. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Still in view: a proposal meets its parliamentary limit
variants.sub: A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote.
variants.body:
The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

A legislature is supposed to decide, not merely to decorate a government's intentions. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Still in view: government legislation fails the vote
variants.sub: A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote. Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point.

A legislature is supposed to decide, not merely to decorate a government's intentions. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
